;Kick-off point of the routine.
;Initialize variables and call Fileman utilities to display a list of
;deficiencies and options for the user to interact with.
5337b990: Call VALM with 'DGJ DEFICIENCY LIST' option to display a list of deficiencies
e5f1261d: Exit the START entry point
d6c9f62e: Call VALM with 'DGJ IRT RECORD LIST' option to display a list of IRT records

c0d57354: Call VALM with 'DGJ DELETE SINGLE' option to delete a single deficiency
6e9e5452: Exit the START2 entry point
97213555: Set DGJTOPT=1 and call VALM with 'DGJ COMP EDIT SINGLE' option to edit a single completed deficiency
828938dc: Exit the START3 entry point
705f4922: Call VALM with 'DGJ COMP EDIT SUPER' option to edit a completed deficiency with supervisor privileges
a32feb34: Exit the START4 entry point
aa2878c6: Call VALM with 'DGJ DELETE SUPER' option to delete a deficiency with supervisor privileges
15f48e9b: Exit the START5 entry point
6e79d5dc: Set DGJVIEW=1, kill XQORS and VALMEVL, and call VALM with 'DGJ IRT VIEW' option to view an IRT record
101519f1: Kill DGJVIEW and exit the START6 entry point
aeff0286: Clear variables used in this routine.
fb29a3ac: If facility identified as multi-divisional, ask which division and store the value. If the user exits, quit.
0c6c6774: If no division is specified, use the institution default division.
845a6bc4: Check if facility is tracking outpatient deficiencies. If not, set flag to prevent outpatient selection.
42305b6e: Initialize counters and loop control variables.
08cc2650: Prompt user to select a patient using the standard DIC lookup.
d40d642a: If user exits the patient lookup, quit.
24497090: If user selects an invalid entry, re-prompt for selection.
2877b963: Store the patient IEN and name components.
c025e22b: Look up and store the patient's ID in VA FileMan format.
737946db: If facility is not tracking outpatients, go to inpatient processing.
95b1e37d: Prompt user to select inpatient or outpatient deficiencies.
13fbca18: Convert user's response to a numeric code.
67c3df3d: If user needs help, explain the options and re-prompt.
e5473db1: Check validity of user's response, display help if needed, and branch accordingly.
